questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui must train young dentists in public health. What is the first piece of advice he should give them?
options: Public health is an administrative constraint
Public health is a mission of service to the patient and society
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Public health is a mission of service to the patient and society.' Dr. Berrada: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada must create a training center in public health. What is the main objective?
options: Train dentists in public health and contracting
questions.explanation: Dr. Berrada explains: 'The objective is to train dentists in public health and contracting.' Dr. Cherkaoui: 'I will participate in this training.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui must evaluate the performance of a young dentist in public health. Which measurement is the most important?
options: The quality of access to care for underserved populations
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'The quality of access to care for underserved populations is the most important measure.' Dr. Berrada: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada must handle a crisis: a patient has been a victim of a charlatan. What is the priority?
options: Provide care to the patient and report the charlatan to the authorities
questions.explanation: Dr. Berrada explains: 'The priority is to provide care to the patient and report the charlatan to the authorities.' Dr. Cherkaoui: 'I will help you manage this situation.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui must train interns in risk management in public health. What is the fundamental principle?
options: Risk management in public health is a responsibility
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Risk management in public health is a fundamental professional responsibility.' Dr. Berrada: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada must create a guide to good practices in public health. What is the main reference?
questions.explanation: Dr. Berrada explains: 'Good practices should be based on Law 07-05 and Decree 2.12.507.' Dr. Cherkaoui: 'I will contribute to this guide.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui must train young dentists in optimizing contracting. What is the key message?
options: Optimization is a service to the patient and society
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Optimizing contracting is a service to the patient and society.' Dr. Berrada: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada must create a research program in public health. What is the main objective?
options: Improve access to dental care for vulnerable populations
questions.explanation: Dr. Berrada explains: 'Research aims to improve access to dental care for vulnerable populations.' Dr. Cherkaoui: 'I will participate in the research.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui must create a reference practice in public health. What is the pillar of excellence?
options: Quality of access to care and prevention
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Excellence is based on the quality of access to care and prevention.' Dr. Berrada: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada must evaluate the impact of contracting on public health. What is the role of contracting?
options: It is essential for access to care for underserved populations
questions.explanation: Dr. Berrada explains: 'Contracting is essential for access to care for underserved populations.' Dr. Cherkaoui: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui must train interns in innovation in public health. What current trend is important?
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Innovation concerns telemedicine, prevention, and public-private partnerships.' Dr. Berrada: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada must create a competency evaluation system in public health. What is the objective?
questions.explanation: Dr. Berrada explains: 'Evaluation aims to improve public health practices.' Dr. Cherkaoui: 'I will participate in the evaluation.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui must handle a conflict related to illegal practice. What is the right attitude?
options: Report illegal practice to the authorities and protect patients
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Reporting illegal practice is a professional duty to protect patients.' Dr. Berrada: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada must write an article on the future of dental public health. Which trend should be emphasized?
options: The decline of dental public health
The importance of access to care for all
The decrease in needs for dental care
questions.explanation: Dr. Berrada explains: 'The future lies in the importance of access to care for all.' Dr. Cherkaoui: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui must create a public health quality label for practices. What are the main criteria?
options: Commitment to prevention and access to care
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Commitment to prevention and access to care are the fundamental criteria.' Dr. Berrada: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada must give a speech on the importance of public health. What message should she convey?
options: Public health is a pillar of human medicine
Public health is of no interest
questions.explanation: Dr. Berrada explains: 'Public health is a pillar of human medicine.' Dr. Cherkaoui: 'I completely agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui must create a scholarship for students in public health. What is the objective?
options: Encourage excellence in dental public health
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Encouraging excellence in public health is an investment for the future.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will support this initiative.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada must pass on his knowledge of public health. What is the most effective method?
questions.explanation: Dr. Berrada explains: 'Personalized mentoring and case studies are the most effective methods.' Dr. Cherkaoui: 'I will invest in mentoring.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui must create a peer network for young dentists in public health. What is the objective?
options: Promote mutual aid and experience sharing
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Mutual aid and sharing are essential for young dentists.' Dr. Berrada: 'I will support this network.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada must write a conclusion to his work on public health. What is the final sentence?
options: Public health is the heart of our social mission
questions.explanation: Dr. Berrada explains: 'Public health is the heart of our social mission.' Dr. Cherkaoui: 'I completely agree.'

options: Public health skills and an example to follow
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Public health skills and example are the most beautiful legacy.' Dr. Berrada: 'I completely agree.'

options: Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission
Mentoring is a source of income
questions.explanation: Dr. Berrada explains: 'Mentoring is a mission of support and transmission.' Dr. Cherkaoui: 'I will convey this message.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui must write a letter to future dentists about public health. What message should he convey?
options: Public health is a noble and essential mission
Public health is of no interest
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui explains: 'Public health is a noble and essential mission.' Dr. Berrada: 'I agree.'

questions.question: Dr. Berrada must create an award for young dentists in public health. What is the purpose?
questions.explanation: Dr. Berrada explains: 'Stimulating excellence in public health is essential for the evolution of the profession.' Dr. Cherkaoui: 'I will support this award.'

questions.question: Dr. Cherkaoui, after a career dedicated to public health, receives a national tribute. Dr. Berrada is by his side. What is Dr. Cherkaoui's message to young dentists?
options: Public health is our social mission
Public health is of no interest
questions.explanation: Dr. Cherkaoui concludes: 'Public health is our social mission. It gives meaning to our practice.' Dr. Berrada: 'I am proud of you.'
